name: Helcular's Revenge
summary: In Hillsbrad, Helcular's Revenge begins with a rod and three flames. Novice Thaivand gives you the Rod of Helcular. Helcular fashioned three ceremonial pyres for his most powerful spell, and each flame must charge the rod before it is driven into Helcular's grave in Southshore.

sections.title: The Three Flames
sections.body: Helcular fashioned three ceremonial pyres for his most powerful spell, and each flame must charge the rod. The Flames of Azel and Veraz burn in the yeti cave at Darrow Hill, within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a small cave above the caverns, farther north in the mountains near Growless Cave.

sections.title: The Grave in Southshore
sections.body: After all three flames charge the rod, it is to be driven into Helcular's grave at Southshore, a heavily guarded human town. The graveyard lies in the town's northeast corner by the river. Helcular's grave is at the graveyard's southeastern corner.

sections.title: After the Ritual
sections.body: When the charged rod is driven into Helcular's grave, the ground rumbles greatly. Helcular returns and wanders the Southshore graveyard, attacking people nearby.

faq.q: Where are the three ceremonial flames located?
faq.answer: Azel's flame and Veraz's flame are in the yeti cave at Darrow Hill, within the Foothill Caverns in Hillsbrad Foothills. Uzel's flame is in a small cave above those caverns, farther north in the mountains near Growless Cave in the Alterac Mountains.
Helcular's grave is at Southshore, a heavily guarded human town. The graveyard lies in the town's northeast corner by the river, and the grave is at its southeastern corner.

faq.q: Who provides the Rod of Helcular?
faq.answer: The rod comes from Novice Thaivand, Helcular's apprentice.
Before this, Novice Thaivand needed Helcular's Rod found. Thaivand is Helcular's apprentice. A human crowd lynched Helcular, and he was buried in the Southshore cemetery.
